cohort: A cohort of 135 pregnant women with pregestational diabetes (73 with T1DM and 62 with T2DM) receiving intensive insulin treatment throughout pregnancy were evaluated.
finding: Women with T1DM had a higher risk of macrosomia associated with weight gain during pregnancy, while women with T2DM showed a higher prevalence of abortion associated with pregestational BMI and total insulin requirement in the first trimester.
